channel.title: Assay release desk
channel.description: New AI model releases and how their launch claims held up against independent measurement.

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5: audit updated
item.description: Anthropic's launch claims for Claude Opus 5.5 were checked against Opus 5 using independent measurements. Result: 3 Hallmarked, 2 Fool's gold. Re-checked on 24 November 2026 against the latest independent data. Fool's gold: The same 40% saving, checked at max effort Hallmarked: Generates output more than 30% faster than Opus 5 Fool's gold: Fewer tokens per task, checked at max effort Hallmarked: Costs about 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads at default effort

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: audit updated
item.description: Google's launch claims for Gemini 4 Argon were checked against Claude Opus 5.5 using independent measurements. Result: 2 Hallmarked, 3 Fool's gold. Re-checked on 24 November 2026 against the latest independent data. Fool's gold: Leads rival frontier models on the Vals Index, ahead of Opus 5.5 Hallmarked: Ranks first on Zapier's AutomationBench at 51.3% Hallmarked: Half Opus 5.5's token price should mean about half the cost per task Fool's gold: The same saving, after the introductory price ends
